kpi.ticketsInfo: Tickets moved to review, done or deployed in the period.
kpi.pointsInfo: Sum of story points of delivered tickets. Reflects complexity more than volume.
kpi.cycleInfo: Median time from “In progress” to “In review”: half of the tickets are delivered faster.
kpi.reworkInfo: Share of tickets that went back (from Review or QA) in the period.
kpi.bugsInfo: Tickets without an estimate (a rough proxy for bugs). Read it with the composition.
kpi.wipInfo: Average number of tickets open at the same time. Above 3, context switching gets costly.

insights.blockedHint: More than 5 days in Review or QA

insights.overrunHint: Longer than the estimate (1 pt = 0.5 d)

dist.driftFaster: Last month’s cycle {n} % shorter than the other months’ average

tickets.caption: Tickets delivered
tickets.empty: No ticket delivered in this period.
tickets.title: Title
tickets.reworkTip: This ticket went back at least once from Review or QA

ticketsCount.label: Tickets per month
ticketsCount.note: Counts tickets moved to review or further during the month (transition date).

pointsSum.label: Points per month
pointsSum.note: Sum of estimates of delivered tickets. Tickets without an estimate are left out.

bugsCount.label: Urgent bugs per month
bugsCount.note: Delivered tickets without an estimate, a rough proxy for urgent bugs: a missing estimate often means unplanned work.

medianDevCycleHours.label: Dev cycle (median)
medianDevCycleHours.note: Median time from “In progress” to “In review”: development time only, without review or QA.

avgSize.label: Average size
avgSize.note: Average estimate of delivered tickets that have one.

dev.title: Profile
dev.bugRatio: {n} % of tickets without an estimate (bug proxy) in the period
dev.cycleInfo: Dev cycle: In progress → In review. Review: In review → QA. QA: until Done. The full height is the whole delivery time; a bar mostly in review or QA points to a bottleneck.
dev.noCycle: No cycle data yet: it appears once tickets are synced with their start and end dates.
dev.compositionInfo: Estimated tickets and tickets without an estimate (bug proxy). A high share without an estimate can point to unplanned debt.
dev.ticketsInfo: Delivery volume per month, not quality.
dev.pointsInfo: Points delivered per month: complexity rather than volume.
